parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence (sodomy laws struck in 2022), no documented universal-exposure measure (no facility, custody, ward or border rule), and no documented targeting or trans-specific violence — so no tier-1 or tier-2 feature. Positives: a functioning constitutional court that extended privacy/expression rights, LGBTI organisations permitted to register. Negatives that keep it out of Reduced Risk: LGBTQ people systematically avoid law enforcement (police are not a working protection route), no discrimination or hate-crime statute leaves a visitor with no remedy for service refusal or assault framing, no documented social acceptance of gender diversity, and dated official hostility (2005 port exclusion, 2011 government stance). The dossier is thin and enforcement toward trans people post-2022 is unresolved; silence here is not safety, but neither does it document exposure. Net: no known visitor-facing restriction, thin recourse, uncertain climate — mid Elevated/low Reduced boundary.
